files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
banaction = iptables-allports
mta = mail
[suhosin]
enabled = true
logpath = /nonexistent/%(__name__)s.log
maxretry =  3 
findtime = 3600
action = %(action_)s
ignoreip = 
[nginx-botsearch]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
logpath = /dev/null tail
maxretry = 10
bantime = 10m
[apache-noscript]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
bantime = -1
ignoreip = ::1 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.1
usedns = warn
